annotation_scope: Codex automated visual review of every frame in two unmarked native-rate source intervals, using enlarged temporal source sheets. Approximate visible streak/component centers, not cork positions. Unknown/overlapping/out-of-crop observations remain uncertain, never absent. No interpolation or TrackNet predictions used to supply labels. Existing sparse model previews had already been seen; this is not blind or held-out labeling. Same match/camera; upstream training overlap unknown.
coordinate_method: Manual approximate native-pixel centers from 2x enlarged raw crops, checked in 4x local crops. Local bright-pixel connected components refine some visually identified centers; no evaluated model output, identity inference or interpolation. Tolerance sensitivity reported separately.
